1925, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1
Page 26 Cont.
July 28 Anxiously Awaiting X-RayExamination. Mrs. Stella Walkowska 75 (8348 Centerline) in serious pains as well is to have examina- tion for supposed cancer of gall-stones etc. tomorrow is enrolled for 2 yrs. to-night 10 P.M.
Aug. 5 Michael Dupras 60 in October, Trenton N.J. Enrolled as against cancer of Stomach, June 12th. Today reported cured.
9th Hopless Case - Given Up By All. Para Martin Burda 43 of 4351 Junction Ave. 3 months paralized from his neck down is enrolled To-day perpetually.
11 Blanch Racine 21 - 3223 Hudson, Enrolled. After being home from T.B. Sanitorium about a year but not well. Now wants to go to work, feeling so well.
16 Esther Maas 13, 7872 Helen Ave. - blood poison from bad tooth followed by "flue then brain-fever, now spinal manigitis. All started about Aug. 1st -- weak lungs for a few years, is enrol- led 2nd time this evening at 8 P.M.
24 Escapes Safe From Smashup. Donat Ray 22, 1007 Crane Enrolled for 2 yrs. June 30th Escapes without scratch though thrown 20 feet in air and stunned 2 hour. His four friends were all taken to hospital in bad condition. - Enrolles again for year further.
27 Mrs. Lilly Witherell, non Cath. 57, 485 Kitchener Ave. Paralized ten years ago through over-dose calmel, given up as hopeless by all doctors, is enrolled this evening in S.M.A.
31 Stephen J. Hook 65, 4525 Avery, Enrolled August 10th as against cancer on nose reports To-day as improving before reaching home, has not bothered him since, going away gradually. To-day enrol- led again as against head-aches. Sept. 26 Now completely cured - just a weak scar left. Oct. 14, 1933 Same Mr. Hook was burried yesterday -+Oct. 10 - hardening of arteries.
Aug. 31 Sleeping Sickness Improving. Nelson Reynolds (non Cath) 26, Toronto, nephew of above S.J. Hook enrolled also Aug. 10th as against hopeless sleeping-sickness; reported as positively better.
